{{Top|leg}}
'''Fynn''' was an orphaned [[Gender/Legends|boy]] who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He stayed in an old warehouse in the town of [[Gadrin]], along with some other orphans. He was captured by [[Task Force Vermin]], a [[Thaereian military]] unit that was tasked with kidnapping children on Cularin.
